## What it is

The plain disc that drops into the four top slots. Outside Ø91, hole Ø83, 1.2 mm thick. No tabs.

## Design notes

- The band is 4 mm wide, centred on the 43.5 mm coil radius.
- The slot in each tower is 0.2 mm larger, 1.4 mm deep.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.2
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing on edge. 1.2 mm on its side is a ribbon.
